content: Session 2026-08-09: Vector fully working (socket /run/vector/syslog.sock, vector-setup boot service, config after apk install, VRL ?? {} fix). Per-subvolume btrfs compression via btrfs property set (zstd data, NoCoW swap). Harness 22/22 checks incl fstab_vs_mount, vector_*, apk_packages. All packages single apk add. EFI keys generated after package install (Secure Boot fix, pending harness revalidation). internalRules cleaned (services in packageLogic). Next: dummy package for less, test Secure Boot fix, commit+push.
less package issue: solve via dummy package providing less. apk masking (!less in world) conflicts with bat explicit dependency. NOT implemented yet.

Per-subvolume btrfs compression: mount root WITHOUT compression, create subvols, then btrfs property set compression zstd on data subvols. NoCoW subvols get chattr +C, swapfile also chattr +m (NOCOMPRESS). fstab NoCoW entries carry compress=no.

Vector socket on /run/vector/syslog.sock (NOT /dev/log — vector user cannot create socket in /dev). vector-setup service (boot stage, after localmount) creates /run/vector, symlink /dev/log, chown vector:vector /var/log (no -R). Config written AFTER apk install. Check: apk info | grep -q '^vector$' (init-system agnostic).

EFI keys (efi-mkkeys -s 'FeralOS' -o /etc/uefi-keys) generated AFTER package install, matching reference chroot.sh flow. WriteSecurebootConf skips if /etc/uefi-keys/db.key missing. Fix for 50-secureboot.hook 'Can't load key' error — pending harness revalidation.

internalRules.yaml cleaned: defaultRunlevels only base OS services (sysinit/boot/default/shutdown). All package-triggered services in packageLogic (eudev udev trio, vector, earlyoom, cronie, chrony, dbus, openssh, smartmontools, acpid, irqbalance, fwupd, incus, qemu, zram, btrfs, cryptsetup). modules service removed (booster loads /etc/modules).
